name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Run Ruff Lint (no auto-fix)
        run: uv run ruff check .

      - name: Verify Ruff Formatting (no auto-fix)
        run: uv run ruff format --check .

  typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Run Mypy
        run: uv run mypy apps packages

      - name: Run Mypy (website)
        run: uv run --directory website mypy .

  security:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Run Bandit
        run: uv run bandit -c pyproject.toml -r apps packages

      - name: Run Bandit (website)
        run: uv run bandit -c pyproject.toml -r website/

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12"]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Pytest
        run: |
          uv run pytest \
            --cov=agentic_odi_cli \
            --cov=agentic_odi_connectors \
            --cov=agentic_odi_core \
            --cov=agentic_odi_mcp_server \
            --cov=agentic_odi_studio_api \
            --cov-report=term-missing \
            --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml

      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: coverage-${{ matrix.python-version }}
          path: coverage.xml
          if-no-files-found: error

      # One upload per run is enough; the 3.12 report is the canonical one.
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        if: ${{ matrix.python-version == '3.12' }}
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: coverage.xml
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, typecheck, security, test]
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: CLI reports a version
        run: |
          version="$(uv run python -m agentic_odi_cli --version)"
          [ -n "$version" ]
          echo "OK: $version"

      - name: CLI exposes connectors commands
        run: |
          help="$(uv run python -m agentic_odi_cli connectors --help)"
          echo "$help" | grep -q list
          echo "$help" | grep -q ingest
          echo "OK: connectors help"

      - name: Installer installs from a simulated release
        run: bash scripts/tests/install_e2e.sh

      - name: MCP server boots and serves /mcp
        run: |
          uv run python -m agentic_odi_mcp_server > /tmp/mcp_server.log 2>&1 &
          SERVER_PID=$!
          probe() {
            curl -sfX POST http://localhost:8000/mcp \
              -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
              -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"initialize","id":1,"params":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"ci","version":"1"}}}' \
              -o /dev/null
          }
          ok=0
          for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
            if probe; then ok=1; break; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          kill "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
          wait "$SERVER_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
          if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "MCP server did not respond on :8000/mcp"
            cat /tmp/mcp_server.log
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK: MCP server responded with 200"

      - name: Living Studio sidecar serves the studio API
        run: |
          AGENTIC_ODI_BACKEND=mcp uv run python -m agentic_odi_studio_api.main > /tmp/sidecar.log 2>&1 &
          SIDECAR_PID=$!
          probe() {
            curl -fsS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8100/api/health/mcp \
              -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
              -d '{"mcp_url":"http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp"}' -o /dev/null &&
              curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:8100/api/canvas?mcp_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp" -o /dev/null
          }
          ok=0
          for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
            if probe; then ok=1; break; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          kill "$SIDECAR_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
          wait "$SIDECAR_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
          if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "Living Studio sidecar did not respond on :8100"
            cat /tmp/sidecar.log
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "OK: sidecar studio API responded with 200"

      - name: scripts/dev.py brings up both services and stops cleanly
        run: |
          uv run python scripts/dev.py > /tmp/clientrun.log 2>&1 &
          RUN_PID=$!
          probe() {
            curl -sf -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8100/api/config &&
              curl -sfX POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp \
                -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
                -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"initialize","id":1,"params":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"ci","version":"1"}}}' \
                -o /dev/null
          }
          ok=0
          for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
            if probe; then ok=1; break; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$ok" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "scripts/dev.py did not bring up both services"
            cat /tmp/clientrun.log
            kill "$RUN_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
            exit 1
          fi
          kill -INT "$RUN_PID"
          wait "$RUN_PID"
          echo "OK: both services stopped cleanly"

  website:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup

      - name: Pytest (website)
        run: uv run --directory website pytest tests/

      - name: Build site (rsync)
        run: |
          mkdir -p _site
          rsync -av website/ _site/ --exclude='tests/' --exclude='tools/'

  studio:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
        working-directory: apps/studio
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "lts/*"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: apps/studio/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Unit tests
        run: npm test -- --run

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

      - name: Verify generated API types are up to date
        run: |
          npm run gen:api-types
          git diff --exit-code -- src/api/schema.d.ts

  tauri-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
        working-directory: apps/studio/src-tauri
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Linux webview dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev build-essential curl wget file \
            libxdo-dev libssl-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - uses: swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: apps/studio/src-tauri -> target

      - name: Cargo fmt
        run: cargo fmt --check

      - name: Cargo clippy
        run: cargo clippy -- -D warnings

      - name: Cargo check
        run: cargo check

  tauri-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Linux webview dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev build-essential curl wget file \
            libxdo-dev libssl-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "lts/*"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: apps/studio/package-lock.json

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - uses: swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          workspaces: apps/studio/src-tauri -> target

      - name: Install frontend dependencies
        run: npm ci
        working-directory: apps/studio

      - name: Configure updater artifacts
        working-directory: apps/studio
        env:
          SIGNING_KEY: ${{ secrets.TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$SIGNING_KEY" ]; then
            echo 'TAURI_CONFIG={"bundle":{"createUpdaterArtifacts":false}}' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo "No TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY provided — building without signed updater artifacts."
          fi

      - name: Build desktop bundle
        working-directory: apps/studio
        env:
          TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: npm run tauri build

      - name: Upload desktop bundles
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: tauri-bundles-linux
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            apps/studio/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/deb/*.deb
            apps/studio/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/appimage/*.AppImage
            apps/studio/src-tauri/target/release/bundle/appimage/*.AppImage.sig

  ci-green:
    name: CI green
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, typecheck, security, test, smoke, website, studio, tauri-check, tauri-build]
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Verify all required jobs succeeded
        run: |
          results='${{ join(needs.*.result, ' ') }}'
          echo "Job results: $results"
          for result in $results; do
            if [ "$result" != "success" ]; then
              echo "::error::A required job did not succeed ($results)"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "OK: all required jobs succeeded"

name: release-please

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

#   1. release-please opens/updates the release PR
#   2. this workflow arms auto-merge on it (the repo requires the `CI green`
#      status check on main, so it merges only once CI is green)
#   3. the merge is pushed by the GitHub App below, which is what makes the
#      push trigger this workflow again, cut the tag, and start the asset
#      builds. GITHUB_TOKEN-authored pushes and merges trigger nothing, which
#      is why releases used to need a maintainer.
permissions:
  contents: write
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  release-please:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check for GitHub App credentials
        id: app-check
        env:
          APP_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PLEASE_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
          APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PLEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$APP_CLIENT_ID" ] && [ -n "$APP_PRIVATE_KEY" ]; then
            echo "configured=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "configured=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::warning title=Release automation is degraded::RELEASE_PLEASE_APP_CLIENT_ID and/or RELEASE_PLEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY are missing, so release-please falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN. GitHub holds workflow runs created from GITHUB_TOKEN-authored pushes (\"This workflow requires approval from a maintainer\") and ignores the tag it creates, so this release needs a maintainer approval and ships without binaries. See 'Release automation' in README.md."
          fi

      - name: Create GitHub App token
        id: app-token
        if: steps.app-check.outputs.configured == 'true'
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v3
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PLEASE_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_PLEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          permission-contents: write
          permission-issues: write
          permission-pull-requests: write

      - name: Release Please
        id: release
        uses: googleapis/release-please-action@v4
        with:
          config-file: release-please-config.json
          manifest-file: .release-please-manifest.json
          token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}

      - name: Arm auto-merge on the release PR
        id: auto-merge
        if: steps.release.outputs.prs_created == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}
          PRS: ${{ steps.release.outputs.prs }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for pr in $(echo "$PRS" | jq -r '.[].number'); do
            state="$(gh pr view "$pr" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json state --jq .state)"

              echo "Skipping #$pr (state: $state)"
              continue
            fi
            echo "Arming auto-merge on #$pr"
            gh pr merge --auto --squash "$pr" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
          done

name: e2e-install

# Runs after the `release` workflow publishes a tag's assets: installing straight
# off the tag push raced the asset uploads and 404'd every time.
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["release"]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: "Release tag to test (e.g. v0.3.0)"
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  e2e-linux-macos:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Resolve release tag
        id: tag
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          DISPATCH_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
          RUN_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tag="${DISPATCH_TAG:-$RUN_BRANCH}"
          if ! gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            tag="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/latest" --jq .tag_name)"
          fi
          case "$tag" in
            v*) ;;
            *) echo "::error::Could not resolve a release tag (got '$tag')"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Testing $tag"
      - name: Install
        env:
          TAG: ${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          curl -fsSL "https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/download/$TAG/install.sh" \
            | AGENTIC_ODI_INSTALL_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/odi-home" AGENTIC_ODI_BIN_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/odi-bin" bash
      - name: Smoke test
        run: |
          export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/odi-bin:$PATH"
          odi --version
          odi --help
          odi outcomes score 8 2

  e2e-windows:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Resolve release tag
        id: tag
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          DISPATCH_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
          RUN_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
          $tag = $env:DISPATCH_TAG
          if (-not $tag) { $tag = $env:RUN_BRANCH }
          gh api "repos/$env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$tag" *> $null
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            $tag = gh api "repos/$env:GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/latest" --jq .tag_name
          }
          if ($tag -notmatch '^v') { throw "Could not resolve a release tag (got '$tag')" }
          "tag=$tag" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append -Encoding utf8
          Write-Output "Testing $tag"
      - name: Install
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          TAG: ${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/download/$env:TAG/install.ps1"
          $env:AGENTIC_ODI_INSTALL_DIR = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\odi-home"
          $env:AGENTIC_ODI_BIN_DIR = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\odi-bin"
          irm $url | iex
      - name: Smoke test
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $env:PATH = "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\odi-bin;$env:PATH"

          odi --help
          odi outcomes score 8 2

# Agentic ODI Codebase Overview

## 1. Project type and language
- **Language**: Python 3.10+ (requires-python >= 3.10 in pyproject.toml)
- **Package manager**: `uv` (modern Python package manager by Astral)
- **Project type**: Outcome-Driven Innovation (ODI) tool using Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- **Description**: "an MCP server, chat client, CLI, and external connectors" — experimental testbed for MCP-ODI integration

## 2. Workspace structure (uv workspace)
The root `pyproject.toml` defines a workspace with 5 members:

| Path | Package | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/cli/` | `agentic_odi_cli` | Typer CLI with interactive chat, full entity CRUD, connectors, scoring |
| `apps/mcp-server/` | `agentic_odi_mcp_server` | FastMCP server exposing Jobs, Steps, Desired Outcomes, Evidence over HTTP (SQLite default) |
| `apps/studio-api/` | `agentic_odi_studio_api` | FastAPI "Living Studio sidecar" — serves config, health, canvas, SSE chat |
| `apps/studio/` | React + TypeScript + Vite + Tauri 2 | Living Studio SPA and desktop shell |
| `packages/connectors/` | `agentic_odi_connectors` | Pluggable MCP and REST connectors with presets and ingest sink |
| `packages/core/` | `agentic_odi_core` | Domain models, ODIService business logic, repository implementations, opportunity-score computation |

## 3. CI/CD Configuration

### GitHub Actions workflows (`.github/workflows/`)

**`.github/workflows/ci.yml`** — Main CI pipeline on push/PR to `main`:
- **lint**: Ruff check + format verification
- **typecheck**: MyPy for `apps packages` and `website`; npm lint/typecheck/lint for studio
- **security**: Bandit security scanning
- **test**: Pytest matrix across Python 3.10, 3.11, 3.12 with coverage upload to Codecov
- **smoke**: End-to-end verification after all jobs succeed — CLI version, connectors help, installer script, MCP server boot, Studio sidecar, `scripts/dev.py`
- **website**: Pytest + rsync build
- **studio**: Node/npm setup, npm lint/typecheck/tests/build + API typegen verification
- **tauri-check**: Rust toolchain + npm + `cargo fmt/check/clippy`
- **tauri-build**: Full Tauri desktop bundle build (Linux deb/appimage, macOS app, Windows installer)
- **ci-green**: Verification that all required jobs succeeded

**`.github/workflows/release.yml`** — On tag `v*`:
- Builds binaries for Linux (x86_64/arm64), macOS (arm64/intel), Windows (x86_64)
- Produces SHA256 checksums
- Uploads assets via `softprops/action-gh-release`
- Also uploads `scripts/install.sh` and `scripts/install.ps1`

**`.github/workflows/release-please.yml`** — Release automation:
- Uses `googleapis/release-please-action` to create/update release PRs
- Arms auto-merge once CI is green
- Falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN if Release Please app credentials are missing

**`.github/workflows/tauri-release.yml`** — On tag `v*`, for desktop releases:
- Preflight checks for TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY
- Builds for Linux, macOS (arm64/x86_64), Windows
- Uses `tauri-apps/tauri-action` to attach bundles to existing release

**`.github/workflows/e2e-install.yml`** — End-to-end after release:
- Installs binary from release tag
- Runs smoke tests: `odi --version`, `odi --help`, `odi outcomes score 8 2`

### Setup action (`.github/actions/setup/action.yml`)
Composite action that:
1. Installs `astral-sh/setup-uv@v5` (version 0.13.0)
2. Installs selected Python version
3. Runs `uv sync --all-packages --locked`

## 4. Dependabot Configuration
`.github/dependabot.yml` — Two update schedules, both weekly with limit of 5 open PRs:
- **GitHub Actions** ecosystem updates (directory: `/`)
- **pip** package updates (directory: `/`)

## 5. Package Manager and Test Setup

### `pyproject.toml` (root)
- `[tool.uv.workspace]` defines members as listed above
- `[tool.pytest.ini_options]`:
  - `asyncio_mode = "strict"`
  - `pythonpath = ["."]`
  - `testpaths = ["apps", "packages", "tests", "website"]`
- `[tool.coverage.run]` sources: `agentic_odi_cli`, `agentic_odi_connectors`, `agentic_odi_core`, `agentic_odi_mcp_server`, `agentic_odi_studio_api`
- Dev dependencies: bandlet, mypy, pyinstaller, pytest, pytest-asyncio, pytest-cov, ruff, pillow

### Test runner: `pytest`
- Runs from `apps`, `packages`, `tests`, `website` directories
- Coverage reported both terminal and XML format
- Codecov upload on Python 3.12 (canonical report)

### No PR templates found
- Searches for `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE`, `ISSUE_TEMPLATE`, `.github/**/*.md` templates yielded no results
- Contributing workflow relies on local development checks (lint/format/test) as documented in `docs/development.md`
